settings.hero_desc: A pair of sculpted forearms crossing to cradle a potted plant, mounted as a striking wall piece in a gleaming metallic finish. Trailing greenery spills over the hands for a living, sculptural feature - available in copper, bronze or silver for homes, lobbies and retail interiors.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your finish, size, pose and mounting
settings.s1_body: Two lifelike forearms cross and open their hands to hold a potted plant, turning greenery into living wall art. Trailing species like pothos and ivy cascade over the arms for a lush, dramatic effect, while the crook of the crossed arms forms a natural shelf for the pot. Wall-mounted and finished in gleaming metallic tones, it frees up your surfaces and becomes an instant talking point. We finish it in your chosen colour and can adapt the pose, size and mounting to your space.
settings.case_body: Created as a decorative feature, these cradling hands became a talking point in the space - holding a plant with an elegance that made guests stop and ask where it came from.
settings.case_quote: Everyone asks about it. It's beautiful, useful and completely unlike anything else we have.
settings.prov_p: The best decor does more than sit there. A sculpture that cradles a plant brings warmth, meaning and function to a space - and starts conversations.
